name: Impact measurement (theory of change + quantified indicators)

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.32-4.38 — Sustainability Impact requires theory of change with quantified indicators of contribution to outcome)

summary: Tests whether the project has a documented theory of change linking the asset's activities to the impact objective, supported by quantified indicators of contribution. PS23/16 ¶4.34 requires the theory of change to be 'robust'; PB methodology v3.5 aligned band requires (a) a written theory of change with explicit causal chain from activities to outcomes, and (b) ≥3 quantified indicators with baselines and targets sourced from a recognised taxonomy (EU Taxonomy substantial contribution indicators, SFDR L2 RTS Annex I PAIs, or sector-recognised equivalents).
